scope: Prospective engine latency/phase and worker-conformance workload. Not browser/app-startup or human authoring time, blind quality, independent research evaluation or a speed claim. Three small exploratory fixtures informed selection; this is not held-out evaluation. Frozen before this formal baseline, before any worker implementation.

cases.scope: Existing public24-row offline demo: mean/seed bootstrap and supported true comparison claim.
Original complete83h sparse child-heading fixture; all source names retained.
Original complete83h grouped table context/units/headers; no shortening.

schedule.first_request: fresh owned font/config directory per case; record separately, do not pool with warm fonts
schedule.order: listed case order; one cold-font ordinary request, seven warm-font ordinary fresh subprocesses, one instrumented warm-font request per case
schedule.future_worker_order: counterbalance one-shot/worker blocks per case with independent equivalent initially fresh owned font/config directories; preserve first startup separately
schedule.os_page_cache: uncontrolled; no OS cache flush or human/general inference

clock.primary: perf_counter around actual PreviewState.render; includes canonical prepare/convert/native subprocess/report/geometry binding, excludes upload, artifact hashing, harness startup and browser/HTTP/app startup
clock.translation: one-shot current local_request convert wall time, parent timing wrapper
clock.renderer: actual preview._run wall time, includes child process lifecycle and all strict exports
clock.instrumentation: separate request with explicit nested-aware direct timers; not pooled into primary medians; inclusive phases overlap

required_worker_controls: fresh script namespace and closed figures for every request
immutable current input/script/run ownership and protocol framing
timeout/crash kills owned descendants and next-request recovery
same full strict checks and requested export behavior
minimum/current/fresh-installed controls and exact all9/Figure CI
amendments: Changing case membership, accepted outcomes or metric/gate definitions requires a new version retaining original protocol, runs and reasons. Executor/instrumentation source hashes accompany every run; this baseline has no worker.
